This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Biology and appearance==
This sentient species was distinguished by their pale, wrinkled, [[Color|tan]] skin.<ref name="TROS" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROSDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' to [[35 ABY]].</ref> a member of this species was present on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species was made for the [[2019]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TROS" /> They were intended to appear in an extended segment on the planet Tatooine which took place at the end of the film, though this segment was ultimately cut.<ref name="Tom Wilton">{{Twitter|tomKwilton|status/1241287872369524736|[[Tom Wilton]]|date=2020-03-21|quote=Can’t help with the first 3 (although the 1st guy looks like a Kimiji character to me) but the last pic is a pull on head that I got fitted for in Jordan as a background character to populate the scene where Rey travels to Tatooine. They went in a different direction in the end|archivefile=File:TomWiltonNickKellington-TROSExtras-Twitter.png}} {{C|In response to: Need some help! Trying to figure out where these characters are supposed to be (which planet/scene) in #StarWars #TheRiseOfSkywalker. Maybe @missingwords can tell, or @tomKwilton @NickKellington have seen them on set? The last one I've not seen outside creature shop.}}</ref><ref name="Nick Kellington">{{Twitter|NickKellington|status/1241290391913140226|[[Nick Kellington]]|date=2020-03-21|quote=And the Freddy Kruger-esque alien appeared on Pasaana and was played by one of our talented CFX sculptors Darren Nevin.|archivefile=File:TomWiltonNickKellington-TROSExtras-Twitter.png}} {{C|In response to: Need some help! Trying to figure out where these characters are supposed to be (which planet/scene) in #StarWars #TheRiseOfSkywalker. Maybe @missingwords can tell, or @tomKwilton @NickKellington have seen them on set? The last one I've not seen outside creature shop.}}</ref> This species was both designed<ref name="Jake Lunt Davies">{{Twitter|JakeLuntDavies|status/1869154133888106577|[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2024-12-17|quote=I’m not certain but it’s either Luke Fisher or Darren himself - Darren was a sculptor in CFX who also designed a few aliens.|archivefile=File:JakeLuntDavies-AlienDesign-Twitter.png}} {{C|Hey @JakeLuntDavies, doing some research into this alien seemingly cut from the Pasaana scene in TROS played by Darren Nevin (@fx_dna I believe), and I was curious if you happened to know who may have designed them? You're usually pretty well informed into stuff like this!}}</ref><ref name="Luke D Fisher">{{Threads|luke.d.fisher|post/DDsqfaMilXX|[[Luke Fisher]]|date=2024-12-17|quote=Hi Matthew. This was based on my design and sculpted by Darren Nevin. Can’t tell you much more than that really, the design was chosen from a bunch of background character designs we did.|archivefile=File:LukeFisher-AlienDesign-Threads.png}} {{C|Hey @luke.d.fisher, not sure if you're even active on here, but it's worth a shot! Been researching the origins of the species seemingly cut from Pasaana in The Rise of Skywalker, and JLD said it was probably designed by either you or Darren Nevin, so I was hoping maybe you could help narrow it's inception down? Any help is appreciated, thanks!}}</ref> and portrayed by sculptor [[Darren Nevin]].<ref name="Nick Kellington" /><ref name="Darren Nevin">{{Instagram|username=jahsonlion|url=p/CIq3vfjDjr8|name=[[Darren Nevin]]|date=2020-12-11|quote=Excited after seeing all the new Star Wars content coming soon! Here’s a character I sculpted on miself😎for The Rise Of Skywalker! Concept design by Luke Fisher @luke.d.fisher, make-up application by Lucy Sibbick @lucysibbickmakeup #starwarsriseofskywalker #starwarsepisode9 #starwars #creaturefx #sculpture #acting #cameo #lucasfilm #lucas #disney|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/LMx20}}</ref>
